comment: Copyright notices for packages whose nuspec declares none, and which ship no
licence file inside the package either. MIT requires the copyright notice to
travel with the software, so leaving the row empty would not discharge the
obligation - but neither would inventing one from the <authors> field.
Every entry below is copied verbatim from the licence file in the project's
own repository, named in 'source'. Maintained by hand; the generator fails
when an entry names a package CashPrism.Shell no longer ships.
assetsComment: Third-party files CashPrism ships that are not NuGet packages, so no
deps.json names them: the fonts and the icon font under the web project's
wwwroot. Licence and copyright are copied verbatim from the licence file
that ships beside each one; the version is the release the files come from.
Maintained by hand; the generator fails when a listed file does not exist.
